def ledger(ops: list[str]) -> tuple[dict[str, int], list[int]]:
    balances: dict[str, int] = {}
    frozen: set[str] = set()
    history: list[tuple] = []
    rejected: list[int] = []

    for i, operation in enumerate(ops):
        tokens = operation.split()
        if not tokens:
            rejected.append(i)
            continue

        verb = tokens[0]

        if verb == "undo":
            if len(tokens) != 1 or not history:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue

            action = history.pop()
            kind = action[0]

            if kind == "open":
                _, account = action
                del balances[account]
                frozen.discard(account)
            elif kind == "balance":
                _, account, old_balance = action
                balances[account] = old_balance
            else:  # frozen state change
                _, account, was_frozen = action
                if was_frozen:
                    frozen.add(account)
                else:
                    frozen.discard(account)
            continue

        if verb == "open":
            if len(tokens) != 3:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            account, amount_text = tokens[1], tokens[2]
            if (not amount_text.isdigit() or
                    any(ch < "0" or ch > "9" for ch in amount_text) or
                    account in balances):
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            balances[account] = int(amount_text)
            history.append(("open", account))

        elif verb == "deposit":
            if len(tokens) != 3:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            account, amount_text = tokens[1], tokens[2]
            if (not amount_text.isdigit() or
                    any(ch < "0" or ch > "9" for ch in amount_text)):
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            amount = int(amount_text)
            if amount <= 0 or account not in balances:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            history.append(("balance", account, balances[account]))
            balances[account] += amount

        elif verb == "withdraw":
            if len(tokens) != 3:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            account, amount_text = tokens[1], tokens[2]
            if (not amount_text.isdigit() or
                    any(ch < "0" or ch > "9" for ch in amount_text)):
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            amount = int(amount_text)
            if (amount <= 0 or account not in balances or
                    account in frozen or balances[account] < amount):
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            history.append(("balance", account, balances[account]))
            balances[account] -= amount

        elif verb == "transfer":
            if len(tokens) != 4:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            source, target, amount_text = tokens[1], tokens[2], tokens[3]
            if (not amount_text.isdigit() or
                    any(ch < "0" or ch > "9" for ch in amount_text)):
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            amount = int(amount_text)
            if (amount <= 0 or source == target or
                    source not in balances or target not in balances or
                    source in frozen or balances[source] < amount):
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            history.append((
                "transfer", source, balances[source], target, balances[target]
            ))
            balances[source] -= amount
            balances[target] += amount

        elif verb == "freeze" or verb == "unfreeze":
            if len(tokens) != 2:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            account = tokens[1]
            if account not in balances:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            if verb == "freeze":
                if account in frozen:
                    rejected.append(i)
                    continue
                history.append(("state", account, False))
                frozen.add(account)
            else:
                if account not in frozen:
                    rejected.append(i)
                    continue
                history.append(("state", account, True))
                frozen.remove(account)

        else:
            rejected.append(i)

    return balances, rejected
